state.background: Review the combined P42-244/P42-245 implementation checkpoint in Plan42. In tests/e2e/consumption-mobile-readability.e2e.spec.ts, P42-244 replaces a loose payload-row lower-bound check with an exact browser assertion: collect only `[data-tooltip-row="true"]` rows, require the expected count, and compare the sorted `data-tooltip-key` multiset against keys for the active chart. The nominal chart uses QUARTERLY_PLAN40_V2_NOMINAL_KEYS (21), the real chart QUARTERLY_PUBLIC_REAL_KEYS (11). P42-245 removes the generic text assertion against the collapsed-remainder phrase `他 N 件`; existing CustomTooltip showAllPayload unit coverage already asserts all supplied mobile values and no collapsed remainder. In the browser the new exact active key set/count directly detects missing, extra, or duplicate keys for both real chart variants. The tooltip remains visible after real taps, with internal scrolling, computed safe-area padding, viewport geometry, and close/tap behavior tested. Ledger rows P42-244/P42-245 are updated. OpenSpec R20e requires every applicable category value on mobile and desktop when showAllPayload is true; no spec text changed.
acceptanceCriteria: P42-244 browser verification checks the complete active chart payload key multiset and count, using the nominal and real public key arrays for the corresponding chart. It detects missing, extra, or duplicate category rows; no arbitrary order requirement is introduced.
The E2E still exercises actual mobile browser chart taps and visible tooltip rendering, and keeps scrolling, safe-area padding, viewport bounds, and close/tap behavior checks.

P42-245's removed generic collapsed-remainder text assertion remains covered at component level by CustomTooltip showAllPayload mobile test: every payload item renders and the collapsed-remainder label is absent. Browser-level full payload is strengthened by P42-244 exact keys/count for both active charts.

The changed implementation satisfies OpenSpec R20e: when showAllPayload=true, every applicable mobile category value is rendered; the E2E now verifies the actual nominal and real chart category sets. No requirement text change is needed.
Ledger entries accurately describe the new split between component rendering coverage and browser series-key parity.

Current verification passes: CustomTooltip Vitest 32/32; final mobile-pixel E2E file 9/9; build from the immediately preceding checkpoint passed and application source has not changed since. Earlier E2E attempts failed on an incorrect expected count (10 versus 21) and then order comparison; expected count now comes from the active public key array and the comparison sorts sets because order is not required. The final run passed.
